dct_description_sm: Beaver Creek is an experimental road site where mitigation techniques, aiming to control permafrost degradation along the Alaska Highway, are being tested since implementation in summer 2008. The site comprises 12 sub-sections including a control sub-section.  Snow surveys were conducted in order to improve our knowledge of local terrain conditions at Beaver Creek test site. Surveys were also intended to evaluate the interaction of the mitigation technique design with snow distribution. This will help in adapting the various designs in order to avoid unwanted concentrated snow accumulation.

dct_title_s: Beaver Creek experimental site snow data
